claim_assessment.assessment: (Ca,Y)Zr(Ti,Mg,Al)2O7, Rd,1989 s.p.; exact label Zirconolite. No IMA accession identifier emitted.
Root is metamict or undetermined polytypoid;2M/3T/3O distinguished from cubic zirkelite. Naturals and synthetic structures in the compilation have separate provenance.

Different Jacupiranga aggregate, one-grain negative Gandolfi test, three crystals examined, quantitative WDS chemistry and BSE zonation; natural occurrence supported without a new structure refinement.
Prior/heated data separated, lamellar mixed analyses and uncertain original host retained, Fig5/6 caption/axis disagreements disclosed.
General identity/natural context only; Afrikanda powder pattern after1000C2h is not the unheated Jacupiranga pattern.

limitations_and_contradictions: One hand-picked grain produced no diffraction pattern after 48 hours. The unsuffixed metamict/undetermined-polytypoid root is supported; no natural 2M, 3T or 3O refinement is demonstrated for this specimen.

Historical Jacupiranga type-locality association is not identity with the earlier type specimen. The purchased aggregate was explicitly a different specimen; its host rock remains uncertain despite heavy-mineral sand provenance and chemical affinity.
Table 1 compiles prior chemistry and Table 2 reproduces historical 1200 C heat-treated lattice parameters; neither constitutes a new unheated structural determination or independent sampling.

More than80 point analyses concern a small number of crystals. Table3 groups six low-Z, eight high-Z and37 lamellar zirconolite analyses plus three calzirtite analyses; these are not independent grains or bulk ore grades.

Lamellae and the microprobe spot are comparable in size. Intermediate compositions may be mixed adjacent zones. Seven-oxygen formulae and proposed cation/valence substitutions are calculated or inferred, not measured site occupancies or oxidation states.
Figure5 caption versus its plotted y expression, and Figure6 caption versus its axes, disagree. No silently repaired axis, substitution regression or exact slope is imported.
Calzirtite inclusions and their separate16-oxygen formulae are not zirconolite measurements. Censored minor-element values do not establish absolute absence.
No biological experiment, leaching control, recovery yield, process scale or jurisdiction-specific criticality claim is supplied by these identity sources. No such fields were invented.

No article-specific SI or separate dataset was identified in the complete original and acquired publisher landing inventory. Generic supplementary-publication navigation is not a study supplement; this is a bounded inventory finding.

The issuing IMA page was fetched now, but the September2026 master PDF was reused from retained round55 bytes and re-inspected. Its1989 s.p. notation is a special-procedure status, not a fabricated numbered accession.
